description: Overview Roads (LGATE-052) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This dataset is derived from layers stored in Landgate’s medium scale Topographic Geodatabase (TGDB). They provide a broad view of the states population centres and roads and rivers networks. © Western Australian Land Information Authority (Landgate). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are network, public, road, state, topo. It offers 5 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, HTML, PDF, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
